title: Pick the board layout
question: Three layouts for the kanban window, in grey blocks. Lock one; the visual design comes after.

options.label: Command bar
options.thesis: A command line in the titlebar does every action; the board sits under it.
options.viewport: Titlebar command input (Cmd K), five full-height columns, card detail in a bottom drawer, key hints in a footer strip.
options.risk: Typed commands are slower than single keys for small moves, so both must exist.

options.label: Three-pane Mac
options.thesis: Mail-style: boards and columns outline on the left, the board in the center, a fixed inspector on the right.
options.viewport: Sidebar with boards and per-column counts, four columns in the center, inspector with the selected card's notes, due date and label.
options.risk: At half-screen width the inspector eats the board, so it must collapse.

options.label: Full-bleed lanes
options.thesis: Columns own the whole window; boards are titlebar tabs; card detail slides in from the right only when open.
options.viewport: Board tabs in the titlebar, five columns edge to edge, an open card panel on the right pushing the lanes left.
options.risk: No permanent home for the board list or search results beyond the tabs.
